Long Haul

تجنب الطقس

Flight planning or tactical maneuvering to avoid hazardous weather areas using deviation, rerouting, or altitude changes.

Questions and answers

What is تجنب الطقس?

In this glossary, تجنب الطقس refers to: Flight planning or tactical maneuvering to avoid hazardous weather areas using deviation, rerouting, or altitude changes.

How is تجنب الطقس used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "طلب انحراف لتجنب الطقس شرق المسار، عاصفة رعدية شديدة أمامنا."

Definition
